newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan seen resuming interim div in 1997/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan seen resuming interim div in 1997/98 - paper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of more than 100 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998 and to resume interim dividend payments that year, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday.
Nissan was not immediately available for comment.
Nissan is likely to pay a three yen interim dividend for 1997/98, making its annual dividend for that year 10 yen, the paper said.
It said Nissan's parent current profit in 1996/97 would grow to about 85 billion yen from an actual current profit of 32.43 billion yen last business year.
Nissan paid an annual dividend of seven yen in 1995/96 but no interim dividend.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said it expected Nissan's profits to show growth in 1996/97 due to the weak yen and the company's restructuring efforts. Profit growth would continue in 1997/98 helped by the yen's fall, it said.
